sinopsis.es: Cuando su padre, Helmut, muere en un accidente, Uli recibe de su madre una caja con ropa de él, y en ella encuentra ropa de mujer. También recibe sus diarios y descubre el secreto familiar: Helmut era «travesti» desde joven y solo en otras ciudades vivía su deseo de mostrarse como mujer.
sinopsis.en: When her father, Helmut, dies in an accident, Uli's mother gives her a box of his clothes, in which she finds women's clothing. She also receives his diaries and uncovers the family secret: Helmut had been a “transvestite” since his youth, and only in other cities acted on his wish to appear as a woman.
